newsitem.title: CHINA: Chinese alligators taught to sleep with trainers.
newsitem.headline: Chinese alligators taught to sleep with trainers.

text.p: Chinese alligator scientists are on such intimate terms with their reptilian charges they even sleep with the scaly beasts, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

A group of researchers in central Anhui province had trained six adult Chinese alligators to perform a series of clever stunts, including one called Sleeping with Alligators, the official agency said.

Other tricks performed by the tamed reptiles, which weighed up to 50 kg (110 lb) and were up to 1.85 metres (six ft) long, included Fighting with Alligators, Putting Hands Into the Mouths of Alligators and Alligator Dancing, Xinhua said.

Alligators native to the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River had been declared a protected species, but new artificial breeding programmes had helped to raise the number surviving in China to 5,000 from just 500 a decade ago, it said.
